notes: Animation: it's now clearly marked that only Typewriter survives the render — Pop and Rise are preview-only and show a warning when picked, so nobody ships expecting them. New: 'Text swaps' tablets in Smart captions — add your own transcript swaps (percent → %, workouts → wo) with ＋/✕, no JSON editing; they apply to both Whisper and Scribe. New: 'Time spent (all sessions)' in Settings — accumulated per-operation totals for today / 7 days / all time, with medians, the assembly cache hit rate and an estimate of the encoding time the cache avoided. New: the clip cache now prunes itself (entries unused for 30 days, and a 20 GB budget), so it can't grow forever; the manual Clear cache button stays. Earlier in this build: preview now matches the render exactly (single layout engine), assemble is ~8x faster (a finished body is normalized once and cached, then joined by stream copy), localizable text headlines, per-phrase styles, second word shadow, scrim fade, caption drag on the preview, Safe zones, transcript number/unit clean-up, the Assemble time board, and 'Hold last caption to end'.
